The report also indicated that the global economy contracted by 3.5% in 2020, marking the steepest decline since the Great Depression. data.title: Sky Harbour Announces Increase to Recent Registered Direct Common Stock Placement, Updates Investor Conference Calendar, and Announces Filing of Construction Reports
data.description: A company in aviation infrastructure, Sky Harbour Group Corporation (NYSE: SKYH, SKYH WS), based in West Harrison, N.Y., is making strides in establishing the initial nationwide network of Home Base Operator (HBO) campuses for business aircraft. The company, also known as SHG, revealed its upcoming investor conferences scheduled for the next two months. Additionally, it submitted its monthly construction reports as part of its operational updates. Moreover, the company boosted its recent registered direct common stock placement by $10 million with the participation of an extra strategic investor.

data.title: Brandywine Realty Trust Announces Upsize and Extension of Expiration of the Previously Announced Tender Offer for the 2029 Notes
data.description: On August 21, 2026, Brandywine Realty Trust (NYSE:BDN) disclosed a $20,000,000 rise in the 2029 Notes' aggregate principal amount accepted, increasing the 2029 Series Cap from $50,000,000 to $70,000,000. Consequently, there is an increase in the Aggregate Maximum Tender Amount, and the expiration date for the 2029 Notes Tender Offer by Brandywine Operating Partnership, LP has been prolonged from August 21, 2026, to August 25, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET. The tender offer pertains to the outstanding 8.875% guaranteed notes due 2029.

data.title: Celsius Holdings to Participate in the Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Conference
data.description: Celsius Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CELH) based in Boca Raton, Florida, has disclosed its participation in the upcoming investor conference. The company will be part of the Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Conference scheduled for Sept. 8, 2026. A special fireside chat webcast is set to take place around 2:15 p.m. ET on the same day. Interested parties can access live webcasts, where available, on the Events & Presentations section of Celsius Holdings, Inc.’s investor relations website at: https://ir.celsiusholdingsinc.com/events-and-presentations/.
